test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Mathematics help/ in developing/ the logical mindset /of students.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect subject-verb agreement.
 
• The word "**Mathematics**" is a singular noun, and therefore, it should be followed by a singular verb.
 
• The correct verb should be "**helps**" instead of "**help**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part D** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**Mathematics** helps in developing the logical mindset of students."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "Mathematics help"** – This part of the sentence contains the error of subject-verb agreement and should be corrected to "Mathematics helps".
 
• **B: "in developing"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "the logical mindset"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **D: "of students"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
